Subject: Monthly commit confirmation + leadership review queue

Team —

This is the monthly pipeline hygiene check for April. Leadership review is scheduled for Tuesday (4/14) at 10:00 PT; I need a consolidated pack by EOD Monday 4/13 so I can circulate to the execs in the morning. Please do the following by end of day Monday: 

- Update commit status on any deals you plan to carry into the leadership commit queue. Mark as COMMIT, COMMIT-PENDING (legal/PO), or AT-RISK.
- In the attached draft workbook, populate the Commit column and a 1-line risk note if status != COMMIT.
- For any >$200k deals, add the latest procurement/PO timeline and the HubSpot deal id in column F.

Marissa — can you attach your regional commit pack as discussed? Vivek — please confirm whether we should keep the north star policy for ‘pending legal’ as COMMIT-PENDING or move them back to AT-RISK for Q2 forecasts. Laura — finance will need an early heads-up if anything moves from COMMIT to AT-RISK.

Attachments: 2026-04-commit-review-draft.xlsx (workbook)

Thanks,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Go-to-Market Operations

Quick note from rollout/ops perspective — I'm leaning toward treating 'legal outstanding' deals as COMMIT-PENDING for the leadership queue (we'd surface caveats) rather than full COMMIT. Rationale: we want predictability in capacity planning, but leadership must see the contingency.

Action items:
- Sales: add an estimated probability (70/50/30) in the workbook for COMMIT-PENDING deals.
- Sales Ops: add a short legal open-items doc for any deal with COMMIT-PENDING (see attached template: legal-open-items.md).

I'll be in the leadership review; if a deal is >$500k with legal outstanding, flag it for a quick pre-read with me so we can decide whether to include it in the top-line commit.
